verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents automatic tracking and alerts for changing federal, state, and local employment laws, plus AI compliance support that monitors regulatory changes. That covers the law-change part of the story. Multi-state tax handling is automated, but nothing shows proactive alerts when a new hire or a new work location creates a compliance obligation. missing for 10: documented alerts triggered by new hires or new locations, detail on how alerts are delivered and configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
